title: Nourishing Smoky Argentinian Beef Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring smoky Argentinian beef, served in a lacquerware bowl and topped with a molten sauce made with oyster sauce, this keto-friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together oyster sauce, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the beef to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness
Transfer the beef to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
Reduce the heat to medium and add the chopped parsley and cilantro to the skillet
Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the herbs are slightly wilted
To assemble the bowls, slice the beef into thin strips and place on top of a bed of wilted herbs in a lacquerware bowl
Drizzle the molten oyster sauce over the top of the beef and serve immediately
